answer: Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the whisper queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1195 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the umber. The opal index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 128 pays that 151 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
